dict.string: ADE AGS uses Bluetooth only when a page asks to sign in with a passkey from a nearby phone.
ADE AGS lets pages use the camera after you approve access.
ADE AGS lets pages use your location after you approve access.
ADE AGS uses passkeys when the site and system support them.
ADE AGS uses the microphone only when you start dictation in the composer.
ADE AGS transcribes your speech on device and inserts the text into the composer for review.
